errorCodes.meaning: No slot the caller may read has this `mnemonic`, or the slot holds no published content yet. Returned alike for a slot that does not exist and one the caller does not own.
The submitted `domain` is not a known hosting domain on this consumer. See [category conventions](../../../_shared/0.1/CONVENTIONS.md#2-unknown-domain-error).

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

entries.description: The slot's history, oldest first. For did:webvh, one per log line; for a method with no log (did:web) a single entry for the current document; for did:webs one per establishment event that changed the document.

parameters.description: The method's parameters as of this entry (did:webvh log parameters). Absent for a method that has none.

state.description: The DID document as of this entry.

versionId.description: The entry's version identifier. Absent for a method that has none.

versionTime.description: When the entry was made, as the entry states it. Absent for a method that records none.

logContent.description: The stored primary artifact verbatim — did.jsonl for did:webvh, the key event stream for did:webs, did.json for did:web. Present iff the request set raw: true.

method.description: The slot's DID method (`webvh`, `web`, `webs`, …). Determines what an entry is.

witnessContent.description: The stored did-witness.json verbatim. Present iff the request set raw: true and the slot holds witness proofs.

raw.description: When true, the response also carries the stored artifacts verbatim. Absent or false means parsed entries only.
